metadata.title: Truck Routes are now Open
metadata.description:
Since the rains come to a complete halt during the winters, the trucks get busy plying up and down the roads. November, December, January and February are the only months when the rains give a break in this region in Eastern Himalayas, dubbed as the wettest region on the earth. 

No rain means materials can be transported regularly and safely through roads. In a quaint isolated village like that of mine in the higher reaches of the West khasi Hills, this is the only season when transport of construction materials and constructions can resume. 
In this video, I am taking the truck down from the hills of Meghalaya to the plains of Assam to get construction supplies for home. Hope the enjoy the trip.
